title: French origins of the Barbarin family name
summary: Barbarin knows little of his father's French family; a grandfather was probably white and mixed with colored women.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: I wanted to ask a little bit before we got about your family background. Being a French name, you told me once somebody had checked the name way back to France. Do you know anything about your father's name?

Yeah, well no. You know, some people was trying to tell me when I was working at the Jazz Limited, that they have a lot of barbers in a little town near Paris. And he said that he's going to, I don't know how he's going to find that out. He's going to look up and see if they're relative to me. You don't think about your father's folks?
How is that? You don't think about your father's folks?
No, I don't know anything. I don't know if my sister may even tell you because you heard my mother and my grandmother talk about that sometimes.
They came from France though I suppose.

Well, his father, he's great grandfather, his grandfather at least, not his father. His grandfather I think was white. He's a little bit. Yeah. Yeah. So that's, that's how most, all the people had. French names I imagine, or Spanish names, I mean that's, colored people, you know what I mean. How that?
